facades.name: NW side over the lock
facades.note: The two lower windows (x 58-105, 158-213), the small upper window (x 283-325) and the roof dormer (x 240-292). Axes from the NE end: 1.6, 3.7, 5.3 (dormer), 6.1 m.

facades.name: NE gable
facades.note: Ground storey: the left window over its shutter panel, the glazed door and the window beside it under one transom; the two 6-over-6 first-floor windows; the attic window between its shutters; the hoist hatch under the apex.

facades.name: SW street gable
facades.note: The glazed door and the window at street level, the two first-floor cross windows, the two small attic windows; the painted name between the ground storey and the first floor is not an opening.
